source.note: Scan without a text layer. Combined Senior Certificate / National Senior Certificate paper (cover and running header: SC/NSC). The PDF includes the cover (printed page 1), the instructions (page 2) and the information sheet (page 15); PDF page n = printed page n. The cover mentions an answer book of 24 pages, which is not in this PDF. Duration 3 hours as printed on the cover. Source file and hash are recorded in sources/maths/manifest.json.

extraction.method: manual transcription from 170 dpi page renders, checked at 400 dpi where needed

questions.stem_md: A Mathematics teacher was curious to establish if her learners' Mathematics marks influenced their Physical Sciences marks. In the table below, the Mathematics and Physical Sciences marks of 15 learners in her class are given as percentages (%).

questions.text_md: Determine the equation of the least squares regression line for the data.
Draw the least squares regression line on the scatter plot provided in the ANSWER BOOK.
Predict the Physical Sciences mark of a learner who achieved $69\%$ for Mathematics.
Write down the correlation coefficient between the Mathematics and Physical Sciences marks for the data.
Comment on the strength of the correlation between the Mathematics and Physical Sciences marks for the data.
What trend did the teacher observe between the results of the two subjects?

questions.stem_md: The number of aircraft landing at the King Shaka International Airport and the Port Elizabeth Airport for the period starting in April 2017 and ending in March 2018, is shown in the double bar graph below.

questions.text_md: The number of aircraft landing at the Port Elizabeth Airport exceeds the number of aircraft landing at the King Shaka International Airport during some months of the given period. During which month is this difference the greatest?
questions.notes: Reading a double bar graph to compare monthly frequencies. No dedicated bar-graph-reading skill; tagged with stat.draw-histogram.

questions.text_md:
The number of aircraft landing at the King Shaka International Airport during these months are:

Calculate the mean for the data.
Calculate the standard deviation for the number of aircraft landing at the King Shaka International Airport for the given period.
Determine the number of months in which the number of aircraft landing at the King Shaka International Airport were within one standard deviation of the mean.

Which ONE of the following statements is CORRECT?

A. During December and January, there were more landings at the Port Elizabeth Airport than at the King Shaka International Airport.

B. There was a greater variation in the number of aircraft landing at the King Shaka International Airport than at the Port Elizabeth Airport for the given period.

C. The standard deviation of the number of landings at the Port Elizabeth Airport will be higher than the standard deviation of the number of landings at the King Shaka International Airport.
questions.notes: A multiple-choice comparison of the double bar graph (variation / standard deviation). Tagged with stat.mean-standard-deviation.

Calculate the value of $\cos\theta$

questions.stem_md:
A landscape artist plans to plant flowers within two concentric circles around a vertical light pole PQ. R is a point on the inner circle and S is a point on the outer circle. R, Q and S lie in the same horizontal plane. RS is a pipe used for the irrigation system in the garden.

* The radius of the inner circle is $r$ units and the radius of the outer circle is QS.
* The angle of elevation from S to P is $30^{\circ}$.
* $\mathrm{R}\hat{\mathrm{Q}}\mathrm{S}=2x$ and $\mathrm{PQ}=\sqrt{3}r$

questions.text_md: Show that $\mathrm{QS}=3r$
Determine, in terms of $r$, the area of the flower garden.
questions.notes: Area of the annulus $\pi((3r)^{2}-r^{2})$. No dedicated circle-area skill; tagged with trig.3d-problem as part of the 3D garden context.

questions.text_md: Show that $\mathrm{RS}=r\sqrt{10-6\cos 2x}$
If $r=10$ metres and $x=56^{\circ}$, calculate RS.
